_comment: Reviewed floor for the Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi flood. Deaths currently NDRRMA / MoHA, 15 Bhadra 09:00 (272+207+151+95+62+55+37+24 = 903). Uncontacted 4,247. Injured 267 (unchanged) / deployed 20,819 / NDRRMA rescued graphic 10,451. The ten-minute cycle reads nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin and mergeSitrep replaces a group only when its parts add up; a failed scrape leaves these numbers standing. Deaths never go down — Police 794 and the bulletin compilation must not put that back over NDRRMA 903. The overview also shows live government figures beside this grid (BIPAD corridor incidents, NDRRMA rescued-persons totals, OPMCM portal counters); those come straight from the portals and are never merged into these numbers. Two rules govern edits. (1) Never sum across groups that the source keeps apart - the `exclusive` flags and `do_not_merge` notes exist because several of these counts overlap, and adding them would invent casualties. (2) Every breakdown must sum to its own stated total; lib/sitrep-merge.ts re-adds them at load and the page shows a warning if either stops reconciling. Do not add Tibet (16 dead) onto Nepal's 903.

breakdowns.caption_en: NDRRMA / MoHA, 15 Bhadra 09:00 — still 267 injured, of whom 156 discharged. Remainder still in treatment. Earlier 13:00 figure was 239.
breakdowns.caption_ne: एनडीआरआरएमए / गृह, १५ भदौ ०९:०० — घाइते अझै २६७, तीमध्ये १५६ डिस्चार्ज। बाँकी उपचाररत। अघिल्लो १३:०० को अंक २३९ थियो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The last published district split (Rasuwa 43, Nuwakot 27, Dhading 3) summed to the old total of 73, not to 267. Kathmandu DEOC 88, Rasuwa Hospital Dhunche 74, and police injured-and-rescued 2,301 are labels for other collections — they are not added to the 267.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: पछिल्लो प्रकाशित जिल्ला विभाजन (रसुवा ४३, नुवाकोट २७, धादिङ ३) पुरानो जम्मा ७३ मा जोडिन्छ, २६७ मा होइन। काठमाडौं डीईओसी ८८, रसुवा अस्पताल धुन्चे ७४ र प्रहरी घाइते तथा उद्धार २,३०१ अन्य संकलनका लेबल हुन् — २६७ मा जोडिँदैनन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: NDRRMA / MoHA, 15 Bhadra 09:00, by reporting body. Earlier evening figure was 2,502.
breakdowns.caption_ne: एनडीआरआरएमए / गृह, १५ भदौ ०९:००, जनाउने निकायअनुसार। अघिल्लो साँझको अंक २,५०२ थियो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The public missing-report forms, Hello Sarkar (140), Madhesh Police (30) and the tourist list (668) are separate collections. The same person can appear in more than one. Do not add this breakdown on top of 4,247. Police 25 are already inside the official 4,247.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: सार्वजनिक हराएको फारम, हेलो सरकार (१४०), मधेश प्रहरी (३०) र पर्यटक सूची (६६८) छुट्टै संकलन हुन्। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ। यो विभाजन ४,२४७ माथि नजोड्नुहोस्। प्रहरी २५ आधिकारिक ४,२४७ भित्र छन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: Security forces, NDRRMA / MoHA 15 Bhadra 09:00. Medical staff, surgical teams and aircraft are counted separately. Earlier evening figure was 20,618.
breakdowns.caption_ne: सुरक्षा निकाय, एनडीआरआरएमए / गृह १५ भदौ ०९:००। स्वास्थ्यकर्मी, सर्जिकल टोली र हवाईजहाज छुट्टै गनिन्छन्। अघिल्लो साँझको अंक २०,६१८ थियो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The 200+ medical staff and 6 surgical teams are not inside the 20,819 security total, and the 14 helicopters are aircraft, not people. NDRRMA also cited 411 helicopter sorties (17 on Monday) — flights, not a second headcount.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: २००+ स्वास्थ्यकर्मी र ६ सर्जिकल टोली २०,८१९ को सुरक्षा जम्मामा समावेश छैनन्, र १४ हेलिकप्टर हवाईजहाज हुन्, मानिस होइनन्। एनडीआरआरएमाले ४११ हेलि उडान (सोमबार १७) पनि भनेको छ — उडान, दोस्रो जनसंख्या होइन।

breakdowns.caption_en: SitRep-6 helicopter rescue. NDRRMA's 10,451 rescued (air and ground, 15 Bhadra 09:00) is a separate graphic — not added here. Army air 3,596 (Nepali 3,344 + foreign 252) is another overlapping count. Earlier graphic was 9,435.
breakdowns.caption_ne: सिटरेप-६ हेलि उद्धार। एनडीआरआरएमएको १०,४५१ उद्धार (हवाई र स्थल, १५ भदौ ०९:००) छुट्टै ग्राफिक हो — यहाँ जोडिँदैन। सेना हवाई ३,५९६ (नेपाली ३,३४४ + विदेशी २५२) अर्को ओभरल्यापिङ गणना हो। अघिल्लो ग्राफिक ९,४३५ थियो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: 14 is the number of helicopters flying, not people rescued. SitRep 1,976, NDRRMA 10,451, army air 3,596 and the army/private heli name-list 654 are not additive.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: १४ भनेको उडानरत हेलिकप्टरको संख्या हो, उद्धार भएका मानिस होइन। सिटरेप १,९७६, एनडीआरआरएमए १०,४५१, सेना हवाई ३,५९६ र सेना/निजी हेलि नामावली ६५४ जोडिँदैनन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: Police, 13 Bhadra 07:00. A label, not a substitute for the official injured figure of 267.
breakdowns.caption_ne: प्रहरी, १३ भदौ ०७:००। लेबल मात्र, आधिकारिक घाइते २६७ को सट्टा होइन।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Kathmandu valley hospitals and Rasuwa Hospital Dhunche describe the same injured people at a different point in their care — they are not added to the 267 or to this police total.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: काठमाडौँ उपत्यकाका अस्पताल र रसुवा अस्पताल धुन्चे उनै घाइतेको उपचारका फरक चरण हुन् — २६७ वा यो प्रहरी जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: As of 14:15, 27 August. Male 341, female 327. Nepali 127, foreign 541.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: A separate collection from the official uncontacted figure of 4,247. Not added to it.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: आधिकारिक सम्पर्कविहीन ४,२४७ भन्दा छुट्टै संकलन। त्यसमा जोडिँदैन।

items.detail_en: paved road fully destroyed · SitRep-3. Copernicus mapped 7.6 km in its AOI — not added.
items.detail_ne: पक्की सडक पूर्ण ध्वस्त · सिटरेप-३। कोपर्निकसले आफ्नो क्षेत्रमा ७.६ कि.मी. नक्सा गरेको — जोडिँदैन।

notes.body_en: More than 100 homes damaged. Five to seven houses left standing in the bazaar. More than 300 people were waiting for rescue.
notes.body_ne: १०० भन्दा बढी घरमा क्षति। बजारमा ५–७ घर मात्र बाँकी। ३०० भन्दा बढी उद्धारको प्रतीक्षामा थिए।

notes.body_en: 26 staff across 8 banks. Branches were washed away at Timure, Syaphrubesi and Betrawati.
notes.body_ne: ८ बैंकका २६ कर्मचारी। टिमुरे, स्याफ्रुबेंसी र बेत्रावतीमा शाखा बगे।

notes.body_en: About 1,000 inmates are safe. The building at Bidur-3 is damaged.
notes.body_ne: करिब १,००० कैदी सुरक्षित छन्। बिदुर-३ को भवनमा क्षति भएको छ।

name_lists.do_not_merge_en: Eight lists, published separately by different offices. The same person can appear on more than one, so they are never added into a single rescue total. The official injured figure stays 267. NDRRMA's graphic of 10,451 rescued is a separate count from these named lists.
name_lists.do_not_merge_ne: आठ सूची, फरक-फरक कार्यालयले छुट्टै प्रकाशित गरेका। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यी एउटै उद्धार जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्। आधिकारिक घाइते संख्या २६७ नै रहन्छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको उद्धार ग्राफिक १०,४५१ यी नामावलीभन्दा छुट्टै गणना हो।

missing_found.do_not_merge_en: Public reports, not official figures. Lists stay separate and names are not merged across them. The official uncontacted figure stays 4,247.
missing_found.do_not_merge_ne: सार्वजनिक जानकारी, आधिकारिक तथ्यांक होइन। सूचीहरू छुट्टै रहन्छन् र नाम मिसाइँदैन। आधिकारिक सम्पर्कविहीन संख्या ४,२४७ नै रहन्छ।
